findings.reason: the section's done-when is not evaluable until the two decisions are locked, so its declaration should record it as waiting on them (or its done-when should state which part is configuration-independent) rather than reading as ready to build.
findings.text: §2 is declared `implementable` yet states its unknowns as "the locked decision `fitted-unknowns` directs" and its vertical freedom as "the locked decision `vertical-freedom` directs", while both decisions carry an empty data-choice and the followup f-ieb-001 records that "§2 waits on the two open fit decisions"; a node dispatched on §2 today must invent the unknown set, and the tolerance bands in clause (1) are calibrated against an EFIT fit of a different configuration than the one the worker would choose

findings.reason: the section's only negative control is neither guaranteed to fire nor well-defined under one live option of the decision §2 waits on, so the node could pass a comparison it never tested.
findings.text: §2 clause (3) asserts that scaling one poloidal-field coil current by 1.05 "leaves at least one band on every case", which is an assumed outcome rather than a constructed one: the bands it must break are wide (axis 0.20 m, q95 2.0, boundary 5 % of span), and nothing in the plan derives the perturbation from them, so a legitimate fit may leave every band intact and the control silently fails to fire, while under the `profiles-and-currents` option of the decision this clause defers to there is no prescribed current to scale at all

findings.reason: the section's central measure needs either a hard ceiling whose violation is a finding, or an explicit statement that the band is advisory and the deliverable is the named step, so the record's status is not ambiguous at review.
findings.text: §4 clause (2) is satisfied when the warm wall per slice at width 16 is "at or below ten times the warm forward solve … or the record names the step that exceeds it", so both a passing and a failing cost are accepted by the same clause and the section carries no negative control; a band that cannot fail measures nothing, and a later reader cannot tell a met budget from a reported overrun

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `/nova/spine-efit-parity` resolves to docs/plans/spine-efit-parity.html under the docs surface's `<path>.html` rule, /nova/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/inverse-seam.svg exists and is committed at 6f06a3995, plan-after converged-forward-solve exists, and the landed-record path follows the archive convention.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §2 clause (3) assumes a 5 % single-coil perturbation breaks a band rather than constructing a perturbation that must, and §4 clause (2) is satisfied by either outcome so its cost band cannot fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §0 names one durable in-git record, docs/evidence/archive/inverse-equilibrium-baseline-landed.html, and §2/§3/§4 write their tables and panels into it rather than into a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach code, symbols or filenames; `fitted-unknowns` and `vertical-freedom` appear only as plan decision keys.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the §0 root cause matches the evidence it cites (spine-efit-parity records "verdict FAIL on ten of twelve metrics with converged_fraction and fixed_point_defect at exactly zero" over 9,573 MAST slices through the corrected read layer, which is exactly the "10 of 12 … no converged fraction on MAST" claim), the §1 premise that nova owns synthetic flux-loop/field-probe/plasma-current responses is supported by nova/equilibrium/{measurement,observation_kernels}.py, every section's measure can be evaluated or is reported below, and no section prescribes a code path, step sequence or symbol.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §1 delivers recovery, §2 the EFIT comparison, §3 the scoreboard, §4 the cost receipt, §5 the retirement-or-scoring decision; each clause set belongs to one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — s2 is declared `implementable` while its whole fit configuration is deferred to the two unlocked decisions `fitted-unknowns` and `vertical-freedom` (plan.html:102-103), and the plan's own followup f-ieb-001 says "§2 waits on the two open fit decisions"; no relationship records that wait.
